newsitem.title: USA: Borg-Warner Pony Express unit gets chief.
newsitem.headline: Borg-Warner Pony Express unit gets chief.

text.p: Borg-Warner Security Corp said Wednesday it named Donald Berger to the position of president of its Pony Express Courier Corp subsidiary, a regional ground courier division which operates in 32 states and is based in Charlotte, North Carolina.
Berger, whose position is effective immediately, succeeds Drew Naber, who resigned August 13. Berger had been president of the Roadway Global Air Inc division of Roadway Services Inc.
Shares of Borg-Warner Security were trading unchanged at 9-1/2.
